mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate over three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing corporate earnings and consumer demand, which in turn drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of rising unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three months signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces earnings for S&P 500 constituents and drives negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of falling real consumption expenditures (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate over three months signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of rising federal funds rates (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production over three months signals weakening manufacturing activity and reduced corporate earnings, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of falling industrial production (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in payroll employment over three months signals labor market tightening, which increases wage pressures and reduces profit margins, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of rising payroll employment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three months signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts earnings for S&P 500 constituents and drives positive forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of rising real consumption expenditures (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the Consumer Price Index over three months signals inflationary pressures, which prompt the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates, reducing equity valuations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of rising CPI (t-test p > 0.05).
